description: This file defines inline functions and includes other headers related to reading and interpreting cache entries, such as determining file modes, types, and path matching within a version control system like Git.

methods.name: unsigned int ce_mode_from_stat(const struct cache_entry * ce,unsigned int mode)
methods.description: Determines the mode of a cache entry based on the stat mode, considering symlinks and executable bits.

methods.name: int ce_to_dtype(const struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Converts a cache entry's mode to a directory entry type (file, directory, symlink, etc.).

methods.name: int ce_path_match(struct index_state * istate,const struct cache_entry * ce,const struct pathspec * pathspec,char * seen)
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry's path matches a given pathspec within an index.

ctags.name: ce_mode_from_stat
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int ce_mode_from_stat(const struct cache_entry *ce,$/

ctags.signature: (struct index_state * istate,const struct cache_entry * ce,const struct pathspec * pathspec,char * seen)
